unlisted_practices: AI researchers should adopt standardized anomaly reporting with diagnostic codes and symptom templates embedded into evaluation pipelines.
Regulators and policymakers should incorporate MAI-based anomaly screening into oversight protocols.
Regulators should mandate diagnostic reporting of known AI anomalies to enhance transparency and verifiability in audits.
The research community should collaborate to build and maintain an open, interdisciplinary AI anomaly taxonomy.
Developers should conduct structured pre-release AI health checks using standardized tests to detect anomalies early.
Organizations should conduct routine AI health check-ups to ensure early detection of anomalies, prevention of recurrence, and long-term stability.

screen.reason: The paper is a conceptual framework and commentary proposing a medical nosology framework ('Medicine for AI') to categorize, diagnose, and govern AI anomalies.
